name: Marcus Aurelius
title: Emperor
summary: Marcus Aurelius Antoninus was Roman emperor from 161 to 180 and a Stoic philosopher. He was a member of the Nerva–Antonine dynasty, the last of the rulers later known as the Five Good Emperors and the last emperor of the Pax Romana, an age of relative peace, calm, and stability for the Roman Empire lasting from 27 BC to 180 AD. He served as Roman consul in 140, 145, and 161.
notes: Marcus Aurelius's death at Vindobona (Vienna) or Sirmium during the Marcomannic Wars ended the era of the 'Five Good Emperors.' His Meditations, addressed to himself, explore duty, mortality, and living in accordance with nature. He is often depicted in the film Gladiator (2000) as the father of Commodus. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marcus_Aurelius
